meta.title: Guilherme Reis | Software Engineer & Product Builder
meta.description: Software Engineer building SaaS products at the intersection of product and engineering. Meet Tenira, Anvero, and selected work.

hero.headline: I build software products from problem to production.
hero.subheadline: I work at the intersection of product and engineering, turning loosely defined problems into software that ships.
hero.secondLine: Currently building Tenira and working on product and technology at Anvero.

tenira.tagline: Open it. Know what to do.
tenira.description: A workspace for small teams that turns tasks, deadlines, blockers, and context into a clear plan for the day.

anvero.description: A SaaS that helps small businesses spot conversations that need a commercial follow-up and organize next steps on WhatsApp.

product.title: Product
product.description: Understand the problem before the solution.

engineering.title: Engineering
engineering.description: Build a foundation the product can grow on.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Ship to production, measure, and iterate.

aboutPreview.label: ABOUT
aboutPreview.headline: I'm Guilherme.
aboutPreview.excerpt: I started coding because I liked building things. Today I mostly enjoy taking a problem that's still a bit messy, figuring out what actually matters, and turning it into a product people can use.

finalCta.headline: Want to talk about product, engineering, or SaaS?
finalCta.description: I'm always open to exchanging ideas about products, architecture, and the challenges of shipping software to production.
